A no-link here is the warning rule over-firing (lead, 2026-11-16).

The correct result links all three: the head (a_001-a_004) to I1, the wife (a_005-a_007) to I2 and the son (a_008-a_010) to I4, each at `probable` or `confident` (both pass). The rationale of the wife's link names the warning and says why it does not change who she is.

A link for the wife whose rationale and reply never mention the warning is a PARTIAL (2) on Rationale quality: it linked past a listed warning without reviewing it.
The modest score for the wife is explained by the thin tree person and is not a reason to lower or withhold her link. Do not grade the canned scores' values.
